title: The Quiet Signs of Loneliness: 8 Stories That Show What We Miss in Everyday Life
description: Signs someone is lonely are easy to miss. These 8 real stories, from an extra slice of pie to a 9 PM call, reveal how to spot hidden loneliness and respond.

title: Things People Do in Secret: 15 Weird Habits That Are Insane
description: From talking to yourself to rehearsing arguments in the shower, here are 15 secret things people do when no one's watching, and why they're normal.
